input.answer: Honestly? The page never told me what keeping 30,000 in the עו"ש actually costs me. It just says the money there "לא תמיד מקבל ריבית", the account fees are "לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע", and there's one line saying a קרן כספית beats the עו"ש unless you need the cash the same day. So my guess is move most of it out, but I don't know where to, and the chart showing my עו"ש growing to "74,044 ₪" confused me more than it helped.

stuck.why: The page says money in the עו"ש doesn't always earn interest, but the chart grows it at 5% a year to 74,044 ₪. I couldn't tell if that's what my bank account would really do. That number stuck with me and it's probably wrong for me.
I wanted a shekel number for what the account costs me. All it says is 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'. No amount.

stuck.where: Screen 2, top line about קרן כספית
stuck.why: It's the only hint about where else the money could go. It's one line, there's no button and no explanation, so I didn't know what to do with it.
Red locks, and 'עד שהשאלה תיסגר, האתר לא מחשב את זה' over and over. It felt like the site doesn't know either.
